source_geometry_self_consistency.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

agent_assumptions: Exterior wall/floor-to-ceiling height 4500mm from elevation chains.
Window sill 1000mm, head 3400mm (2400mm tall) assumed uniformly from elevation window chain 1100/2400/1000.
Door heights 0-2400mm assumed uniformly (interior and exterior) from elevation door chain pattern.
Vestibule area near the east exterior door merged into south_east_room as one physical room rather than a separate small jog, since wall evidence there was a minor step not a full room division.
North room's east-wall window (O6) position estimated from East_view's upper 1500mm segment; exact plan pixel hatch boundary approximate.
South_east_room's east-wall small windows (O9) approximated as one combined opening representing East_view's two small window rectangles near the south end.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
unresolved: Exact pixel extents of each cyan hatch window run were approximated from visible hatch spans rather than measuring every hatch tick individually.
Whether D4/D5 are truly two separate doors or one wide double-leaf door in the corridor/meeting_room wall is uncertain from the overlapping arc symbols; modeled as two doors.
Small wall jog near the east exterior door (vestibule) simplified to a straight partition (PF) rather than the stepped wall visible in the drawing.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

plan_compilation.basis: Outer wall face pixels calibrated to dimension chains: x 246->0m,612->10m (10000mm south facade chain matches north facade chain, wall outer faces); y 880->0m(south wall),151->20m(north wall) using fine 20000mm chain on plan left/right margins matching West_view/East_view 20000mm facades. Interior wall/door pixel positions observed directly from plan cyan door arcs and gray wall lines. Vertical opening heights assumed from elevation drawings: exterior wall height 4500mm, windows sill 1000mm/head 3400mm, doors 0-2400mm (elevation chains showed 1100/2400/1000 for windows and ~1900/2400/200 for doors, consistent with these assumed heights).

warnings.guidance: x=36.6 px/m and y=36.45 px/m disagree by 0.410678%, over the 0.300000% limit — at least one endpoint pair or transcribed dimension is likely wrong. Do not silently trust the blended px_per_m below: re-crop and re-measure both axes' anchors at their dimension-chain extension-line intersections, then recalibrate. If you must proceed now, prefer the single-axis scale (axis_px_per_m) for geometry measured along that axis over the blended value, and record this disagreement instead of treating the reading as clean.

limits: Two caller-supplied anchors per axis define the transform but do not independently close a dimension chain.
The overlay does not inspect original pixels or automatically decide positional error.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.
